space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

task.description: What the bundle is for, in plain words. Its words are searched as terms, with no query syntax. Without it the knowledge section is left out (no-task) and memory is listed by authority and recency

project.description: Only memory of this project, or with no project when a person wrote it

session.description: The session the bundle is for; a label, not a filter

sections.description: The sections to assemble, in any order; they are placed in the order knowledge, semantic, procedural, episodic. episodic runs only when named

maxBytes.description: The most bytes of the whole result, as the output budget measures it; the smaller of this and the call's budget applies

render.description: text also returns data.text, the quoted block a harness injects, and drops each item's text field

maxChars.description: The most UTF-16 code units of data.text

asOf.description: Read memory as of this RFC 3339 instant, for both valid and recorded time; default: now. Knowledge is not bitemporal
